source_evidence: Exact-head verification: local HEAD and PR #37 headRefOid both resolve to 222b19a9001e35baaf73678116320dd1ddc9528c; the PR is open against main.

The correction in src/jev_factorio/lua/fair_actions.lua assigns local player = fair.actor() before discovery uses player.surface. fair.actor() obtains game.get_player(1) and rejects disconnected/replaced characters, cheat mode, and any speed other than 1; discovery only filters entities and returns identity data, without cursor selection, movement, mining, transfers, or control-state changes.

src/jev_factorio/backends/native_factory.py bounds generated exploration to an integer 1..32 chunk radius and passes only radius * 32 (at most 1024 tiles) to discovery. It validates returned coordinates, resource identity, and surface index before admitting a fair resource target. The existing harvest route still walks normally and begin_mine independently enforces native reach and cursor selection.

src/jev_factorio/lua/fair_actions.lua clears the legacy nth-tick-60 GUI callback at load/bind and wraps inventory inspection with pcall cleanup on both success and error while preserving returned values or the error. Existing normal walking, mining_state-based harvesting, standard interaction reach, and game.speed == 1 guards remain intact.

src/jev_factorio/supervisor.py validates production-extension dependencies, records the four gameplay configuration fields immutably in supervisor state, and forwards the same scheduling and opted-in extension flags to every gameplay command.
The corrected discovery test saves the native player, makes game.get_player return it, and clears global player before invoking discovery; focused relevant tests passed: 274 passed.
